name: Claude Swap
author: mrdrbrdr
description: claude-swap in the Omarchy bar: which Claude Code account is active, every account's limits, one-click switching, the auto-switch threshold and on/off, and account management. Can drive several machines at once over ssh.

barWidget.description: Bar icon with the active Claude account and its fullest limit; dropdown with every account's 5-hour, weekly and model meters, switch buttons, auto-switch toggle and threshold, and account management

schema.label: Machines
schema.description: Comma-separated machines to drive together: "local" is this computer, anything else an ssh destination with key login (e.g. "server,local"). The first one is primary: its slot numbers, threshold and best pick are the ones used.

schema.label: Name for this machine
schema.description: Label shown for this computer when several machines are driven. Empty = its hostname.
